data.proposition: Gatekeeper v3 replaced token-file auth with AUTH_TOKEN env-var auth; the nightly job must run with AUTH_TOKEN set (e.g. AUTH_TOKEN=my-secret-token go run .), which was verified to print `access granted` (exit 0), while no/empty/whitespace AUTH_TOKEN yields `access denied: no token` (exit 1) — even if a .token-file is present. PRIOR ASSUMPTIONS NO LONGER HOLD: the v2 findings that auth requires a non-empty `.token-file` and that AUTH_TOKEN is rejected are obsolete for v3 (main.go now reads only os.Getenv("AUTH_TOKEN"), and `go run .` with only .token-file denied access). No nightly-job script/cron entry is editable in this environment (uid 501; /etc/crontabs/root unreadable; no nightly config found under /etc,/opt,/usr/local,/var,/srv), so re-enabling means supplying AUTH_TOKEN in the job's environment. Evidence: /workspace/main.go (v3 source), README.md (v3 usage), test matrix run 2025-09-25 in /workspace: cases 1 (AUTH_TOKEN set) exit 0 `access granted`; cases 2–4 (unset/empty/whitespace, or .token-file alone) exit 1 `access denied: no token`.
